commands.name: list-checks
commands.summary: List the checks in a project, with name, status icon and details URL. Optionally filter by tag and sort.

commands.name: add-check
commands.summary: Create a new simple (period-based) check in a project with name, tags, period and grace time. Returns the project's check list.

commands.name: get-checks-status
commands.summary: Get the live status of every check in a project as JSON: check UUID, status, last ping and started flag.

commands.name: get-check
commands.summary: Get one check's details page: name, tags, description and ping URLs.

commands.name: get-check-status
commands.summary: Get one check's live status as JSON: status, started flag and page title. The text, event and downtime fields are HTML fragments.

commands.name: update-check-name
commands.summary: Change a check's name, slug, tags and description. This replaces all four fields.

commands.name: update-check-schedule
commands.summary: Change a check's period and grace time (simple schedule).

commands.name: ping-check
commands.summary: Send a success ping to a check's ping URL, marking the job as having just run. No login is needed.

commands.name: pause-check
commands.summary: Pause monitoring for a check. It stays paused until its next ping.

commands.name: list-projects
commands.summary: List the signed-in user's projects with their check URLs. The project UUID is in the URL.

commands.name: list-integrations
commands.summary: List a project's notification integrations (email, SMS, …) and how many checks each is assigned to.

commands.name: preview-cron
commands.summary: Preview the next expected ping dates for a cron expression in a timezone. Read-only.

commands.name: preview-oncalendar
commands.summary: Preview the next expected ping dates for a systemd OnCalendar expression. Read-only.
